# Release notes

The newest release is first. In Odoo the version number starts with the Odoo version, so release 1.1.0 for Odoo 20.0 shows as `20.0.1.1.0`.

## 1.0.15

*2026-11-07, Odoo 17.0 - 20.0*

- First release, on the Jazi Seller API v2 with your own API token (live or sandbox).
- Link products already on Jazi by seller SKU (internal reference or barcode); Odoo never creates products from Jazi.
- Jazi Categories screen: every Jazi category in English and Arabic, matched to Odoo categories, with ready-to-list and on-Jazi counts and List Products by category.
- List on Jazi: category details, colours and sizes matched, brand, weight, size and photos checked before sending; created and submitted for review, review status followed.
- Jazi Products: English and Arabic names and descriptions, brand and category details kept in Odoo; Update on Jazi (details, photos, price and stock, submit), Read from Jazi, Fill from Odoo, Translate to Arabic with Google Translate.
- Stock from several warehouses with a buffer, sent when it moves; prices from the store pricelist with a special price, on a schedule; batch results checked.
- Orders by signed notifications and a scheduled check, as sales orders for your Jazi customer priced from the pricelist; fulfilment and AWB sent when the delivery is validated.
- Schedules and failure alerts per store, job queue with retries, log, dashboard card, test copies read only.
- Needs Commerce Bridge 1.0.23 (from the WooCommerce connector repository) and Odoo's Delivery app, installed with it.
